artBrief: **Samurai travel story.** A wandering scholar in a straw hat rests beside a milestone, carrying a bundle of books beneath an autumn tree. No rank insignia.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Samurai travel story. A wandering scholar in a straw hat rests beside a milestone, carrying a bundle of books beneath an autumn tree. No rank insignia. A peaceful small wandering scholar with a broad straw hat and visible book bundle under one red maple branch. Warm russet and muted blue, restful travel scene.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
